nodes.label: Interactive Parish Diorama Runtime Compositor Plan
nodes.description: Proposed six-milestone plan for a scene-first viewport whose geometry is composed at runtime from curated asset atoms, hotspots, and simulation-driven NPC slots.

nodes.label: Engine-Owned Semantic Scene Layout
nodes.description: The compositor pivot rejects generated full plates as gameplay geometry: data and code own layer order, routes, labels, NPC slots, and interaction while AI art supplies replaceable bounded assets.

nodes.label: Human-Curated Asset Transaction
nodes.description: The art tool records candidate status transitions, rejects blank or invalid artifacts, exports only accepted assets, and requires a human to approve every player-visible atom in the vertical slice.

nodes.label: Three-Scene Diorama Vertical Slice
nodes.description: Kilteevan Main Lane, The Crossroads, and Darcy's Pub form the proposed first accepted slice, with complete travel hotspots, NPC slots, screenshots, and state-parity proof.

edges.description: Owning geometry in data and code is the central rationale for the runtime compositor.
The art-tool workflow supplies validated atoms to the compositor.
The three-scene slice is the plan's first full content proof.
The diorama proof intends to expose scene state through the MCP bridge whose registration lifecycle is addressed by the cold-start plan.
